Method of Attack: Disguised as a legitimate game installer for a fake Pokemon NFT card game website to install remote access tool
Installs NetSupport remote access tool (RAT) to gain unauthorized remote control over victim's device
Creates hidden files in %APPDATA% and adds startup entry to persist on system
Used to steal data, install other malware, and spread within networks
Attack Vector: Malicious executable downloaded from fake Pokemon NFT card game websites (pokemon-go[.]io and beta-pokemoncards[.]io)
Social engineering via fake game installer disguised as legitimate software
Indicators of Compromise: Hidden folder in %APPDATA% containing NetSupport RAT files
Startup folder entry for NetSupport RAT
